subject: Emotions
title: Disgust and Prejudice
description: Learn Disgust and Prejudice in one minute.

hook.text: Nazi propaganda drew Jews as rats and vermin. Dehumanization always starts with disgust language.

buildup.text: When one group describes another as 'dirty' or 'impure,' violence becomes psychologically easier.

discovery.text: David Livingstone Smith showed that every genocide in history used disgust-based dehumanizing rhetoric.

twist.text: Brain scans show that extreme prejudice reduces activity in regions for human recognition. We stop seeing people.

climax.text: Disgust doesn't just reflect hatred. It enables it by stripping the target's humanity.

punchline.text: The path to atrocity begins with the word 'filthy.'

quiz.question: What did David Livingstone Smith find about genocide?
